Winning se zyada love choose karo.
Empathy woh willingness hai jo tumhe affect hone de.
Doosri rooh ko samajhne ka ek hi tareeqa—pyaar.
Love wo heal kare jo logic na kar paye.
Jitna care, utna hurt bhi.
Empathy berahmi ka antidote hai.
Trust moments mein banta hai, aur moments mein toot jaata hai.
Pyaar mutual giving aur receiving se banta hai.
Pyaar sirf grow hone ka chance maangta.
Rishton ko emotional honesty chahiye.
Sab just better love karne ki koshish me.
Kisi ko safe feel karwane ki wajah bano.
Empathy dusre ki reality ke liye jagah banati.
Love mutual feeling, one-way sacrifice nahi.
Hum har situation control nahi kar sakte, par hum pyaar se respond karna control kar sakte hain.
Kisi ka deep pyaar strength deta, aur deep pyaar courage.
Dusron ka khayal rakhna pyaar ki bunyaad.
Pyar ki chhoon se har koi kavi ban jata hai.
Pyaar ki shuruaat: jise love karte, unhe free rehne do.
Empathy ka matlab hai: kisi aur ke dard/khushi mein apne andar ki aawaz dhoondhna.
Love hai next right thing karna.
Dusre ko samajhna: unke andar wahi world dhoondhna.
Kindness pyaar ban sakti hai.
Hum apni bahari stithi nahi choose karte, par response choose karte.
Empathy se suno; purpose se bolo.
Pyaar andha nahi hota; woh kam nahi, zyada dekhta hai.
Dost woh hota hai jo aapke baare me sab jaan-ta hai, aur phir bhi pyaar karta hai.
Kisi se be-inteha pyar milna taqat deta hai, aur kisi ko be-inteha pyar karna himmat deta hai.
Rishton mein chhota act bhi bada hota.
Sabse bada gift understanding hai.
Koi bhi empathy act chhota nahi hota.
